`ctc-tokens.txt` is the public pinned omnilingual CTC vocabulary used by the
production native alignment adapter. SHA-256:
`a7a044c52cb29cbe8b0dc1953e92cefd4ca16b0ed968177b6beab21f9a7d0b31`.
It was copied from the isolated hash-verified model qualification artifact.

The mounted long-refinement tests supply synthetic CTC score emissions at
explicitly authored word onsets. They exercise overlap ownership, bounded audio,
transactional publication and editor timing/export; they do not measure acoustic
recognition or alignment quality.
